confidence_notes: I based the restaurant and coffee anchors on aggregated cost-of-living figures for Tottori found by web search: cappuccino about ¥575, budget meal about ¥1,694 and mid-range dinner for two about ¥5,588. Those sources are crowdsourced and may be out of date. I found no Tottori-specific beer price. The beer anchor comes from national Japanese ranges, which I adjusted to a typical izakaya draft at about ¥500–600. Cocktail and wine are estimates I set from their usual price relationship to beer in regional Japan, so they are less certain. All accommodation anchors are my own estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any booking sites. Tottori has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Tottori with other smaller regional Japanese cities such as Matsue and Yonago. Prices there are below Tokyo and Osaka, and hotels are mostly mid-range business hotels near the station.
